headline: Stable line gets a fix for a failing Enhanced graphics lighting bake on PAL level 11
summary: The stable line moved once, and it was a single fix (#189) rather than a release pull request from develop. Preparing the lighting for Enhanced graphics could fail on PAL level 11 because a path check gave different answers depending on its direction. Both directions must now be clear, and the pull request's author reports that the level then bakes all 254 regions. Issue #173, which reported this error, was closed the same day.
